query:
SELECT cc.id, cc.nome, COUNT(lc.id) as qtd_lancamentos, SUM(lc.valor) as total_valor
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY cc.id, cc.nome
ORDER BY total_valor DESC;
